description: This source file defines a REST API resource class `LoanCOBCatchUpApiResource` for handling Loan Chain of Business (COB) catch-up operations in the Fineract project. It provides endpoints to retrieve the oldest COB processed loan, initiate the COB catch-up process, and check if the catch-up is currently running.

classes.name: LoanCOBCatchUpApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource for managing Loan COB catch-up operations, including fetching the oldest COB processed loan, starting catch-up, and checking the catch-up status.

methods.name: getOldestCOBProcessedLoan
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the oldest COB processed loan and its COB business date.

methods.name: executeLoanCOBCatchUp
methods.description: Handles POST requests to start the Loan COB catch-up process if it is not already running and if there are loans to process.

methods.name: isCatchUpRunning
methods.description: Handles GET requests to determine if the Loan COB catch-up process is currently active.
